mapper.update: update userlogin set password = #{newPwd} where userName = #{userName} and password = #{oldPwd}
mapper.delete: delete from userlogin where userName = CAST(#{id} AS CHAR)
mapper.select: select userName,password,role from userlogin where userName = #{uname} and password = #{pwd} and role = #{role}

select userName,password from userlogin
where userName like '%' #{userName} '%'
order by userID
